scenicChapters.title: Polish Tatra Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 33 km this is Polish Tatra Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

polish-tatra-road.story: 159 km one way from Kraków - plan on about 2 h 38 of riding. The highest point is about 1,050 m. It crosses from Poland into Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
